patch.summary:
Choose Zoho Desk only if your buying job matches “Budget helpdesk in the Zoho suite — free 3 agents; Express $7, Standard $14, Professional ” rather than Freshservice's shape. Choose Freshservice only if your buying job matches “Freshworks ITSM service desk — Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99 agent/mo annual. ITSM land” rather than Zoho Desk's shape. Workflow advantage: Zoho Desk leans helpdesk-ticketing, knowledge-base-self-service; Freshservice leans itsm-service-desk. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Zoho Desk is Budget helpdesk in the Zoho suite — free 3 agents; Express $7, Standard $14, Professional $23, Enterprise $40 agent/mo annual.; Freshservice is Freshworks ITSM service desk — Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99 agent/mo annual. ITSM landscape; no cross-cluster comparisons..
- Company-size focus: Zoho Desk (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Freshservice (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Zoho Desk-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, knowledge-base-self-service vs Freshservice-leaning itsm-service-desk.
- Researched limits: Zoho Desk — Pricing page may show INR — confirm USD before budgeting; Freshservice — ITSM primary — not customer ecommerce helpdesk (Freshdesk/Gorgias).

Limitations — Zoho Desk: Pricing page may show INR — confirm USD before budgeting; UI depth and polish below Zendesk Suite at enterprise scale; Freshservice: ITSM primary — not customer ecommerce helpdesk (Freshdesk/Gorgias); No cross-cluster comparisons with live-chat or SMB helpdesk peers.

Poor-fit cases: Zoho Desk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing page may show INR — confirm USD before budgeting · Freshservice is a poor fit when that limitation bites: ITSM primary — not customer ecommerce helpdesk (Freshdesk/Gorgias) · Avoid Zoho Desk if you actually need Freshservice's motion (Freshworks ITSM service desk — Starter $19, Growth $49, Pro $99 agent/mo annual.)
